title: Built-in `CONFIG_PHY_ROCKCHIP_INNO_VIDEO_COMBO_PHY=y` hangs the boot at
notes: the PHY's first power-on, before any console; loading the module from `/init`
(`taq102-display`) is the workaround and the cause is open (`README.md`,
"The display, and what the boot images were really doing wrong"). Patch
